item.title: Some opals are vulnerable to heat and drying
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Excessive heating or drying can lead to cracks or crazing in some opals.
EXIMUTC view: Choose care based on the type of opal and its individual stability.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/opal-care-cleaning
